name: A dependable first clear
label: PROGRESSION · COMFORT
text: A mixed Low/High Rank setup built around survival and your weapon’s essentials. Upgrade defense as you advance instead of waiting for a perfect matching set.
pieces: Use available armor for Health Boost and useful weapon skills
Improve the weapon along a reliable upgrade path
Keep a slot or charm flexible for the next threat
note: This is a skill-first template. Exact pieces depend on your weapon and unlocked materials.

name: High Rank raw critical
label: HIGH RANK · RAW
text: For physical-focused melee weapons that can maintain sharpness and reliably hit suitable parts. Drachen’s set bonus is a notable late High Rank route after its difficult collaboration content.
pieces: Compare a mixed affinity setup with a Drachen-based route
Choose enough affinity to support your sharpness plan
Keep a survival option rather than copying every damage slot
note: Drachen requires Behemoth-related materials. It is an endgame destination, not a first-story recommendation.

name: High Rank elemental toolkit
label: HIGH RANK · ELEMENT
text: Bow and Dual Blades often benefit from matching elements to the target. Keep several weapons instead of forcing one elemental choice into every hunt.
pieces: Consider the Rathalos two-piece Critical Element route
Pair the correct element with a suitable sharpness or charge profile
Balance stamina skills with your actual play pattern
note: The best elemental target can change with monster armor or phase. Check the monster profile.

name: Your first Master Rank set
label: EARLY MR · COMFORT
text: Use early Master Rank pieces for a defense step, while preserving the skills that make your weapon work. A few sensible upgrades are better than struggling in an outdated High Rank glass cannon.
pieces: Compare accessible Beotodus, Bone, and other early MR pieces
Keep Health Boost and weapon essentials where practical
Choose a readily upgraded Master Rank weapon
note: This is a starting direction; inspect each alpha/beta piece and the decorations you actually own.

name: Sharpness & ammo uptime
label: STORY / POST-STORY · UPTIME
text: Nargacuga’s three-piece True Razor Sharp/Spare Shot can be useful for appropriate weapons. Teostra’s three-piece Master’s Touch is a different route for affinity-focused melee.
pieces: Choose the set bonus that supports your weapon
Build enough affinity for Master’s Touch to be reliable
Check bowgun ammo, recoil, and reload before judging a gun
note: These bonuses are alternatives with different conditions. They are not equally useful on every weapon.

name: Pre-Fatalis raw foundation
label: POST-STORY · RAW
text: Three Teostra pieces and two Raging Brachydios pieces are a familiar physical melee foundation: Master’s Touch plus Agitator Secret. Adapt it to the weapon and your available decorations.
pieces: Teostra ×3 for Master’s Touch
Raging Brachydios ×2 for Agitator Secret
A weapon with a workable affinity and sharpness profile
note: Conditional affinity matters. Add comfort if maintaining the required conditions is costing faints.

name: Build an elemental library
label: ENDGAME · ELEMENT
text: Compare Kjárr weapons, Silver Rathalos True Critical Element, and Safi’jiiva set options. Match the setup to the weapon rather than combining set names without checking their effects.
pieces: Kjárr weapons can supply Critical Element on eligible weapons
Silver Rathalos ×4 grants True Critical Element
Safi sets trade health management for elemental and affinity benefits
note: Safi armor’s health-drain behavior requires practice. These are separate build routes, not one set.

name: Fatalis: a flexible foundation
label: LATE ENDGAME · FLEXIBLE
text: Fatalis equipment supplies exceptional set-bonus flexibility and slots. Four pieces grant Transcendence, including health and stamina benefits that change how you allocate comfort skills.
pieces: Fatalis ×2 grants Inheritance
Fatalis ×4 grants Transcendence
Use the remaining slot and charm to fit your weapon
note: Four-piece Transcendence replaces the usual need for Health Boost in that setup. It does not make every weapon’s elemental or matchup options obsolete.
